questions.title: Preorder Traversal
questions.description:
The node type is defined for you as typedef struct TNode { int val; struct TNode *left, *right; } TNode; and the harness builds a binary tree from the input (line 1: n; line 2: n level-order values, -1 marks a missing child).

The program scaffolding (includes and main) is already set up for you.

Implement only this function:

    void preorder_fill(TNode *root, int out[], int *outn)

It must fill out[] with the node values in PREORDER (node, then left subtree, then right subtree) and set *outn to the number of values filled. The harness prints the values space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated level-order values (-1 marks a missing child).

Output Format:
One line with the preorder sequence, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, |val| <= 1000000000, the first value is not -1
